title: Harbor and Letter
author: Tamsin Sterling
blurb: Bram Thornbury, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
